title: Microflow slate screenshot pack for Hosted API getting-started
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact screenshot pack ("microflow slate") for the Hosted API getting-started docs that covers three microflows: (1) model selection card and curated tiers, (2) request composer / request preview with streaming and structured output toggle, and (3) code snippet trio (curl, python SDK, JS/Fetch) showing streaming and function/tool calling. Assets must include desktop, tablet, and mobile crops, plus an isolated terminal-style code tile and a notebook cell mock. Include token cost badge and alt text for accessibility. Aim for consistent visual rhythm with the new quickstart brand tokens and supply source Figma file, layered PNG/PSD exports, and final optimized PNG/JPEG for docs usage.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct microflow screenshots exported: model-card, request-composer, code-trio
Each microflow has desktop (1200px wide), tablet (900px), and mobile (420px) crops
Code snippets include examples for curl, python SDK, and JS/Fetch — all with identical example prompt and truncated streaming output
Includes separate terminal-style code tile and notebook cell PNGs (with syntax highlight and line numbers)
Design handoff delivered: Figma file with named frames + exportable slices, layered PSDs for each crop, and optimized web PNGs placed in Drive
Accessibility: each image has a suggested alt text string and contrast checked against brand WCAG tokens
Reviewed and approved by PM (Linh Tran) and Eng lead (Marco Silva) in last review cycle
All image filenames follow naming convention: hosted-microflow_<microflow>_<device>_v1.png
Assets uploaded to docs Drive folder and referenced in the doc PR
